import os,subprocess,time,json,traceback
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/"scripts/DFG/experiments/artifacts/dfg_v2/prompt8h_v1"
prepare_pid=1310016
status=base/"orchestration_status.json"
def save(data):
 status.write_text(json.dumps(dict(updated_unix=time.time(),**data),indent=2))
save(dict(stage="waiting_for_final_preparation",formal_fit_started=False,automatic_retry=False))
while Path("/proc/"+str(prepare_pid)).exists():
 time.sleep(5)
if not (base/"plan.seal.json").is_file():
 save(dict(stage="stopped",reason="Preparation ended without execution seal",automatic_retry=False))
 raise SystemExit(1)
tests=json.loads((base/"final_regression_tests.json").read_text())
assert tests["total_unique_passed"]==2837 and tests["v2"]["failed"]==0
env=dict(os.environ)
env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",MKL_NUM_THREADS="2",
 TREE_SITTER_LIB_DIR="/home/zhao/SmartContract/ge-sc-llm/build/linux-x86_64")
env.pop("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES",None)
commands=[
 ("pilots",["scripts.DFG.dfg_v2.benchmark_v2.execution","pilots"]),
 ("full_matrix",["scripts.DFG.dfg_v2.benchmark_v2.execution","all"]),
 ("reporting",["scripts.DFG.dfg_v2.benchmark_v2.reporting"])]
for stage,args in commands:
 save(dict(stage=stage,automatic_retry=False))
 cmd=["/home/zhao/miniconda3/envs/mando/bin/python","-B","-m"]+args
 log=base/(stage+"_controller.log")
 with log.open("x") as handle:
  result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=str(root),env=env,stdout=handle,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 if result.returncode:
  save(dict(stage="stopped",failed_stage=stage,exit_code=result.returncode,
   log=str(log),automatic_retry=False,requires_user_review_before_fit_retry=True))
  raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 print("completed stage",stage,flush=True)
save(dict(stage="complete",formal_fits=170,automatic_retry=False))
purpose: Serial authorized preparation-to-pilot-to-full-matrix; any failure stops, no retry
